operators.name: custom_softmax
semantics: Computes softmax along dim specified (in reference model dim is 0)
For each column j, computes exp(x[i,j] - max_i x[i,j]) / sum_i exp(x[i,j] - max_i x[i,j])
Expects 2D contiguous input, output has same shape

operators.name: custom_unsqueeze

returns.shape: [1, N, C] when dim=0; general shape depends on dim

semantics: Adds a dimension of size 1 at specified position dim
In reference model dim=0 so output shape becomes [1, N, C]
Returns a view of the input reshaped to new shape; no data copy required
Softmax along dim=0 (column-wise) on input shape [10000, 100]
Output is same shape [10000, 100], float32, values in (0,1), each column sums to 1
Unsqueeze along dim=0, output shape becomes [1, 10000, 100]
Final output tensor of shape [1, 10000, 100], float32, on GPU
